description: PATRICOVA: Red de Cauces. Plan de acción territorial de carácter sectorial sobre prevención del riesgo de inundación en la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by icvficherosweb.icv.gva.es. All channels that meet any of the following conditions: have been considered by the official cartography prepared by the Valencian Cartographic Institute (ICV) on a scale of 1:10.000 or have a slope basin size greater than 0.5km2. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "PATRICOVA: Channel Network. Territorial action plan of a sectoral nature on flood risk prevention in the Autonomous Comm" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include PATRICOVA, Comunitat Valenciana. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
